label: Whatever has the nine SIMPLE_4, PERFECT_2, INFINITE_1 attributes is LORD_2
paraphrase: Whatever is simple, universally perfect, supremely good, such that whatever is GOD_4 is it (IsTheOneGod: uniqueness only), infinite, altogether immutable, eternal, and has intellect and will is LORD_2: it causes the being of every other being in act as to being and governs every such being (Governs, q.103: directing to an end). Derived (nineAreLordByCauseAndGovernment) from the directing bridge and the q.103 a.3 reading; its creator conjunct is contained by definition in supreme goodness. LORD_2 is not LORD_1 (the primitive dominion of the Dei Filius attributes): authority to dispose and conservation as a separate conjunct are not typed.
